1.e4 c5 2.Na3 Nc6 3.d4.strategy: Plays the usual central break, but d4 is attacked twice and defended only by the queen, so this is a pawn offer. The knight on a3 cannot recapture on d4, so the move depends on quick piece play to pay off.

1.e4 c5 2.Na3 Nc6 3.d4 cxd4.strategy: Takes the pawn. White cannot recapture with the queen, since ...Nxd4 would win it, so Black keeps the extra pawn for now. The price is time: only the knight is developed, and White can start to chase the pawn with natural moves.
